# User API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A person with a BrainSTEM account, who receives roles directly or through groups.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/user/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/users/user/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `user` (detail, create, update), `users` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `email` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`behavior`](/api/modules/behavior/), [`behavioralassay`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/), ## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | number **[read-only]** |
| `email` | string **[read-only]** |
| `first_name` | string; max 150 characters |
| `last_name` | string; max 150 characters |
| `groups_own_json` | string **[read-only]** |
| `profile` | string **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/user/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('user', load_all=True)
records = resp['users']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('user', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.users;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "users": [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "email": "",
            "first_name": "",
            "last_name": "",
            "groups_own_json": "",
            "profile": ""
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/user/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('user', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['user']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('user', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.user;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "email": "",
        "first_name": "",
        "last_name": "",
        "groups_own_json": "",
        "profile": ""
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/user/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('user', id='<id>', data={"first_name": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'first_name', 'new value'), 'user', 'method', 'patch');
```
